brief:
**BLUF:** In Tazewell County and immediate neighbors, VDOT continues intersection improvements on US 19/460 in Claypool Hill through December 2026, while Russell County residents discussed a proposed data center project at a recent public forum amid ongoing power agreement talks. Regionally, Ballad Health received more than $7.5 million in federal grants to expand remote monitoring and technology in Southwest Virginia hospitals and clinics; a fatal house fire occurred in Beckley, Raleigh County, WV, and the City of Bluefield, WV, holds its Christmas tree lighting tonight.[[1]](https://www.balladhealth.org/news/ballad-health-awarded-more-75-million-rural-health-transformation-program-grants-southwest)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for the core area.

In the region, nothing major from state or federal sources matching priorities.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours for the core area.

**Region (nearest first):**  
- Beckley, Raleigh County, WV: One person died in a house fire on South Pike Street reported just before 8 p.m. Sunday. Beckley Fire Department conducted suppression and search-and-rescue; the victim was rescued but later succumbed to injuries. Cause under investigation by Beckley Fire Department Fire Marshals and West Virginia State Fire Marshal’s Office. [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/23/one-dies-beckley-house-fire/)

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:**  
- Claypool Hill, Tazewell County, VA: VDOT intersection improvement project on US 19/460 from Adair Drive to Route 610 ongoing (completion December 2026). Motorists should expect lane shifts and use caution. [source](https://swvasun.com/index26.htm)

No active NWS alerts. No reported power outages, flooding, or other hazards in Tazewell or immediate neighbors.

**Region (nearest first):**  
- No additional significant interstate or major route closures reported in the immediate 200-mile area beyond routine work.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:**  
- Russell County, VA (near Cleveland): Data center developers (Oasis Digital Properties) told residents at a Nov. 18 public forum they are awaiting a power agreement with Appalachian Power to advance the proposed project on 234 acres at the former Moss No. 3 coal mine site in the Russell County Industrial Complex. Concerns raised over transparency, water use, noise, and electricity costs. A development agreement with community benefits is planned. [source](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/11/23/data-center-developers-tell-russell-county-residents-they-are-waiting-on-a-power-agreement-to-advance-their-proposed-project-near-cleveland/)[[2]](https://russellinnovationhub.com/)

**Region:** Nothing additional reported.

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** Nothing new beyond the Russell County data center discussions above.

**Region (nearest first):**  
- Southwest Virginia (Ballad Health facilities including Norton Community Hospital, Lee County Community Hospital, Lonesome Pine Hospital): Ballad Health awarded more than $7.5 million in three Rural Health Transformation Program grants via Virginia Health Care Foundation and VHHA Foundation for expanded remote patient monitoring, provider interoperability/technology upgrades, and charting improvements in electronic health records. [source](https://www.balladhealth.org/news/ballad-health-awarded-more-75-million-rural-health-transformation-program-grants-southwest)[[1]](https://www.balladhealth.org/news/ballad-health-awarded-more-75-million-rural-health-transformation-program-grants-southwest)
- Bluefield, Mercer County, WV: City Christmas tree lighting scheduled for tonight (Monday) at Chicory Square starting with remarks at 5:45 p.m. and lighting at 6 p.m. New displays funded by Cole Foundation and Community Foundation of the Virginias. [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/11/23/city-bluefields-christmas-tree-lighting-is-tonight/)
- McDowell and Raleigh counties, WV: Mountaineer Food Bank making stops November 24 and 25. [source](https://woay.com/mountaineer-food-bank-making-stops-in-mcdowell-and-raleigh-county-on-november-24-and-25/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Bluefield, WV: Christmas tree lighting tonight (Nov. 23).  
- Russell County, VA: Ongoing public input on data center project; power agreement pending.  
- McDowell and Raleigh counties, WV: Mountaineer Food Bank distributions Nov. 24-25.  
- General: Thanksgiving holiday travel; Virginia State Police urging safe driving. No major weather hazards noted.
